description: India: state-level property registration (sale deeds) and circle rates; no national MLS. Access, formats and licensing differ by state.

parcel.note: Survey / khasra / plot numbers vary by state. Use the state's own format and the registration document number.

onboarding: Identify the state registration department's data access route (APIs, bulk, per-record certified copies)
Confirm permitted use for valuation and the fees
Circle rate (guidance value) tables are public per locality and are a floor reference, not a market price
Portal listing data needs a commercial agreement

notes: Declared sale prices can be below transaction value: calibrate against bank-appraised values, and keep the discrepancy visible
Area units vary (sq ft, sq yd, gaj, cent, guntha): normalise explicitly
